_note: Aroma profiles are compositions to look for, not specific products. Editors may link reviewed products in articles.

aromas.name: Cypress and warm stone
aromas.room: Green and cool by day, resinous at night: the smell of a garden terrace after the sun has left it.
aromas.car: A light cypress and bergamot blend keeps the cabin fresh without competing with the lake air.

aromas.name: Lemon leaf and neroli
aromas.room: Bright, bitter-green citrus with soft orange blossom for rooms that open onto the sea.
aromas.car: Best kept very light in a warm car; citrus fades quickly and never cloys.

aromas.name: Vetiver and coconut water
aromas.room: Earthy, cool vetiver softened by a milky, barely sweet coconut note.
aromas.car: Not needed on an island without roads; for the room only.

aromas.name: Iris and soft leather
aromas.room: Powdery iris over clean suede: quiet, elegant and very Parisian in spirit.
aromas.car: A touch of suede and cedar suits a chauffeured car's cabin.

aromas.name: Hinoki and green tea
aromas.room: The clean, lemony wood of a cypress bath with a thread of temple incense.
aromas.car: A faint hinoki note suits a private car between temples.

aromas.name: Bitter orange and cedar
aromas.room: Sunny, slightly bitter citrus over dry wood, for a city of light and tile.
aromas.car: Fresh citrus and cedar for the coast road to Cascais.

aromas.name: Damask rose and cedar
aromas.room: Rose and orange blossom from the garden, cedar from the mountains, a little warmth for evening.
aromas.car: Keep it restrained: a trace of cedar and orange blossom for a drive into the Atlas.

aromas.name: Stone pine and woodsmoke
aromas.room: Resin and a fireplace, with the clean edge of high-altitude air.
aromas.car: Pine and a hint of smoke for the high passes; avoid anything heavy in a heated cabin.

aromas.name: Heather and peat smoke
aromas.room: Honeyed heather and a wisp of smoke: the Highlands after rain.
aromas.car: A small amount of heather and myrtle; the landscape will do the rest.

aromas.name: Fynbos and sea air
aromas.room: Herbal, aromatic Cape botanicals with a salty coastal edge.
aromas.car: A light, herbal note for the coast road; pleasant with the windows down.

aromas.name: Amber and lagoon salt
aromas.room: Warm resin and salt, like a palazzo interior on a winter afternoon.
aromas.car: Not needed in a city without cars; for the room only.

aromas.name: Fig and mimosa
aromas.room: Milky green fig and sunny mimosa for a Riviera room with shutters half-closed.
aromas.car: Just a trace of fig for a convertible; the sea air is the main note.
